d.s: Sika Confibre 51F is a fibrillated polypropylene fibre for use in concrete to reduce the incidence of plastic shrinkage cracking. Sika Confibre 51F increases the strain capacity of the fresh concrete therefore reducing plastic cracking.
a: Increased resistance to plastic shrinkage cracking

sec.t: Complies with ASTM C1116/ C1116M, Type III fiber re-inforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508. Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Part 2, Class 1b .
Product can be stored for indefinite period in a dry environment.

The recommended minimum dose rate of Sika Confibre 51F is 0.9kg (1 bag) per cubic metre of concrete. Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
